terms.en: Fogline Gallery sells the studio's pieces on consignment and keeps a commission of 40% of each sale price. The gallery sends a statement of the month's sales on the 30th of each month and pays the studio the balance with the statement.
terms.zh: 雾线画廊寄售工作室作品，每件按售价收取40%佣金。画廊于每月30日寄出当月销售对账单，并随对账单向工作室支付余款。
